## About
Above and Beyond Auto Repair is a family owned and operated shop in Gladstone, serving drivers across the Northland and the greater Kansas City area. We handle cars and light trucks, domestic and foreign, from brakes and A/C to engines and transmissions.
The name came from a customer. On the way to file the business paperwork, our founder remembered what they'd told him: "Wes, you always go above and beyond the call of duty." We still try to earn that every day.
Our customers have given us a 4.5 rating from 224 Google reviews. They tell us they like that the owners are on site, explain things plainly, and don't push repairs you don't need.

## Services
- Brake services: Brake repairs for cars and light trucks.
- A/C, heating and cooling: Air conditioning, heating and cooling system work.
- Computer diagnostics: Diagnosis and troubleshooting with computer diagnostics to find out what's really going on with your vehicle.
- Engine and transmission repair: Engine repair and transmission work.
- Steering and suspension: Steering and suspension repairs to keep your vehicle handling right.
- MO state inspections: One reviewer came in for a MO state auto inspection and had the repairs needed to pass done on the same visit.
- Emergency towing: Emergency towing is available 24/7 at 816-678-0078.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates at the shop are free.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars and light trucks, both domestic and foreign.

Q: Can I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes, a courtesy ride is available if you need one.

Q: Do you offer student discounts?
A: Yes. If you're a student, just ask for student specials and discounts.
